note: side effect: the bounds check is gone, so page 0 or a negative page returns wrong slices and a page past the end returns [] instead of raising IndexError as documented
issue: The last page is lost when it isn't full: with 25 items and 10 per page, page_count() says 2 and page(items, 3, 10) raises IndexError instead of returning the last 5 items.
commit: Count a partial last page and simplify page()
